Class CsvCardParser

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.data.CsvCardParser
public class CsvCardParser extends Object
Parses card and noble data from a CSV file.

Expected CSV schema (columnar cost format): 

type,id,tier,points,bonus_gem,cost_black,cost_white,cost_red,cost_blue,cost_green
CARD,1,1,0,BLACK,0,1,1,1,1
NOBLE,1,3,0,0,4,0,4

The file path is read from ConfigKeys.FILE_CARDS_DATA. Parsing is fail-fast: any malformed row throws a DataLoadException.
